claims.answer: The public beta offers Intel and Apple Silicon Mac downloads. Windows and Linux are currently waitlisted, rather than shipped. The app installs a product-owned xirp CLI which lists/messages running sessions, imports supported native sessions, creates linked shell terminals and uploads transcripts. Users create a goal-based session, select a native coding agent, steer its terminal, stop/close it, and resume persistent work.

claims.answer: Current detailed docs say sessions run on the user Mac. Portal supplies optional context and receives manually uploaded transcripts rather than executing the coding session. The detailed FAQ says no server/SSH hosting exists, while the homepage broadly says local or remote sessions. No usable current remote mode was established; the discrepancy stays unresolved. The detailed plans page says there is no cloud execution. The broad remote wording on the homepage does not identify a vendor runtime; a vendor-cloud route remains unestablished. The FAQ says sessions persist across app close/reopen. Changelog v0.60.0 distinguishes tmux persistence from direct-terminal fallback; this is same-host continuity, not host-sleep independence.

evidence.title: Xirp: home
evidence.finding: The homepage describes Xirp plus optional Portal context and broadly says sessions can run locally or remotely. Detailed current product docs and plans give a narrower local-only scope.

evidence.title: Xirp: plans
evidence.locator: Xirp plan; FAQ: platforms, remote/cloud, cost and source license
evidence.finding: The standalone Mac beta is free to download/use; Portal Foundations is a separate 60-day trial with later pricing by contact. The detailed FAQ says sessions run locally and there is no cloud execution. Windows/Linux are not currently available.

evidence.title: Xirp: beta
evidence.locator: Get Xirp; Mac download choices; non-Mac waitlist; preview terms
evidence.finding: The public download page offers Apple Silicon and Intel Mac choices without submitting the optional Portal trial request. Non-Mac users join a waitlist.

evidence.title: Xirp: docs-getting-started
evidence.locator: Prerequisites; Install; Accept preview terms; Start a session; coding-agent troubleshooting
evidence.finding: The setup requires a Mac, a supported coding-agent account and initial connectivity, but no separate Xirp account. Native credentials and sandbox controls remain with each coding CLI.

evidence.title: Xirp: docs-sessions
evidence.locator: Create a session; work with terminal; status; workflow labels; worktrees; Command-line tool
evidence.finding: Exact integration documentation selects Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Pi or Cursor and starts a persistent interactive CLI terminal with the goal. It also documents the product-owned xirp CLI for listing/messaging/importing sessions and linked terminals.

evidence.title: Xirp: docs-projects
evidence.finding: The app operates on local folders, can create per-task worktrees and has Git/file views. Selecting a changed file is documented to open its diff; the inspected Git asset itself is clean, with no displayed diff code content.

evidence.title: Xirp: docs-faq
evidence.locator: 1.3 agents; 1.6 source; 1.10 offline; 2.3 persistence; 4.5 telemetry; 5.1 server deployment
evidence.finding: The FAQ explicitly calls Xirp proprietary, keeps agent settings native, documents default-on optional usage metrics and an in-app/env off switch, and says no server/SSH hosting exists today. Required installation availability checks continue when optional metrics are off.

evidence.title: Xirp: docs-settings
evidence.finding: The docs expose tested agent-specific controls while preserving native configuration; Advanced > About has an optional usage telemetry switch that stops collection/delivery and discards queued events.

evidence.title: Xirp: preview-terms
evidence.locator: Preview Terms sections 1-3; rights and compatible agent list
evidence.finding: Dated Xirp-specific preview terms cover a locally installed desktop app with optional Portal. Spotify retains app ownership and lists Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI; the current docs additionally name Pi/Cursor, so those extra agents remain unresolved in this pass.

evidence.title: Xirp: docs-changelog
evidence.locator: v0.67.0 November 13, 2026; v0.66.0 November 12; v0.64.1 November 6
evidence.finding: The latest dated entry inspected is v0.67.0 on 2026-11-13, including minimap/status and diff-view fixes. v0.64.1 removed mandatory account sign-in in favor of installation availability checks.
